readme.text:
> 中文（默认） | [English](README.en.md)

[GitHub](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) · [0.4.1 预发行](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.4.1) · [稳定版 0.3.0](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.3.0) · [GitMCP](https://gitmcp.io/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) · [插件市场目录](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/data/plugins/Archaofan__dsh-source-deck.yml)
SourceDeck 是给 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 用的开源资料工作台。它把“先看看别人怎么做的”从十几个浏览器标签页、零散书签和聊天记录里收进一个侧栏：后台研究、卡片筛选、并排对比，再把选中的仓库引用回当前对话。

大部分产品设计，其实已经有人做过。与其从零重复造轮子，更常见的做法是先找成熟的开源实现，读它的架构、交互和取舍，再决定直接复用、借鉴，还是绕开。

真正麻烦的往往不是“搜不到”，而是搜到之后：十几个仓库怎么快速比较？哪些看过、为什么排除？选中的怎么带回当前对话，让 Agent 基于真实代码继续？

SourceDeck 就是为这个中间过程做的。它把一次调研变成一条可复查的链路：

> 说清需求 → 后台研究 → 卡片筛选 → 并排对比 → 引用回对话 → 继续开发

适合：技术选型、同类/竞品调研、找可复用实现、给 Agent 补真实背景资料。  
不适合：替代深度代码审计，或替代正式的安全/合规评估。

0.4.1 沿用 0.4.0 的界面，本轮没有 UI 变化。以下为 0.4.0 的真实 Host 截图（浅色中文 / 深色英文）；画面中的 QA 来源为合成验收材料，用于展示搜索、排序、对比名单和撤销。

| 浅色 | 深色 |
|---|---|
|  |  |

资料台不是另一个孤立的搜索页。它和左侧对话共用同一个会话上下文，研究结果、筛选决定和引用都留在同一处。

1. **从对话发起**：输入 `/deck 找几个主流 Agent 框架...`，或直接说“用资料台找…”。主 Agent 通过 `deck_search` 启动官方受管子会话；主对话不阻塞，可以继续干活。
2. **结果回到同一会话**：候选进入右侧资料台；对话里保留一张资料卡片，点“在资料台打开”回到原主题。子会话的搜索提示留在子会话，不会把主对话刷满。
3. **在资料台做决定**：保留 / 排除、写原因、收藏、最多四项对比；这些决定按会话/主题隔离，切到别的会话不会串台。
4. **引用回对话**：点“引用到对话”，保留项作为不可变快照进入输入框；原有正文、附件不丢，也不会自动发送。然后继续写“参考这几个仓库，给我们的设计提改进方案”。
5. **改判不影响已插入引用**：之后改判只影响新引用；已插入的是当时快照，发送前可移除。

左侧继续对话，右侧资料台同步；底部输入框已插入 SourceDeck 引用，并续写开发要求。以下为较早版本的联动截图，展示引用流程：

| 项目 | 精确版本 |
|---|---|
| 本插件 | 0.4.1 |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop | 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| @deepseek-ai/cordis | 4.1.0 |

只使用 `0.2.2-rc.1` 的公共接口。0.4.1 是适配该基线的当前预发行；已发布的 0.4.0 只支持 `0.2.1-rc.2`，在 0.2.2-rc.1 环境不会加载。目前只维护这个 RC 基线；更新迭代快的 alpha 版本暂不提供支持。升级到新的 RC 或正式版需要单独评估和验收。

从 [v0.4.1 Release](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.4.1) 下载 `dsh-source-deck-0.4.1.tgz`，在 Desktop 插件管理页选择本地安装，按提示重启。仍停留在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的环境请使用 [v0.4.0 Release](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.4.0)。重复开发安装应使用新版本或带内容哈希的新 tgz 路径；同路径同版本可能被包管理器缓存。

市场收录 PR [#7739](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7739) 已合并。目录更新 [PR #12339](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/12339) 已提交，把条目指向 0.4.1 并在描述中注明支持 `DSH 0.2.2-rc.1`；**合并前目录仍指向 0.3.3（旧基线）**，安装 0.4.1 请使用上述 Release 包。目录收录不等同于已在实际市场界面验收某个版本，详见[市场记录](docs/MARKETPLACE.md)。

- 直接说：`用资料台找几个主流 Agent 框架，比较 stars 和维护活跃度`。模型通过 `deck_search` 启动研究；自然语言触发取决于模型是否调用工具。
- 确定性入口：`/deck 找 Markdown 编辑器，优先开源和可扩展`。带参数开始后台研究，单独 `/deck` 只打开面板。
- 也可点输入框「资料台」、右栏 `+ → 资料台` 或对话卡片「在资料台打开」。历史卡片定位原主题。

研究由官方受管子会话执行，默认继承主会话的模型配置与凭据策略，会产生额外并发模型请求。Host 读取最近主对话作为资料理解上下文。搜索和补搜的内部提示留在子会话；主聊天可继续开发，保留简短的命令/工具状态及资料卡片。

研究工具仅允许 `web_search`、`web_fetch`、`deck_submit_sources`。需要官方网页工具和 spawn provider 可用；无法安全启动时显示失败原因，不自动改配置或升级基线。

可组合搜索标题、URL、说明、筛选原因及已有语言、许可证、标签，例如 `TypeScript MIT`；空格分隔的词需同时匹配。候选与收藏分别记住查询和排序。候选默认原顺序，也可在每轮内按 stars、代码更新时间或名称排序，未知值排后。

对比名单直接显示所选名称，可逐项移除或清空，比较顺序跟随选择，最多四项。不足 620px 时按维度纵向阅读，每个值带来源名称；宽栏使用表格。最近成功保存的本地判定可一键撤销并恢复原原因；切主题、后续同项编辑或发现冲突后失效。

卡片优先显示已有的「研究判断」，详情保留完整判断与简介。新研究的提示要求说明适用点和关键待核验点，并遵循用户明确指定的来源名单或数量；这些要求不构成事实准确性保证。查询、排序、对比和草稿在同主题的输入框入口与历史卡片之间接续。

卡片显示保存状态；引用和直接摘要等待已有筛选写入，失败时保留草稿供重试。研究中约每 2 秒读取一次，静置结果约每 30 秒一次；收藏页或面板隐藏时暂停定期完整读取，返回时刷新。

0.4.1 适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，接口层只把已删除的 `tools.presentAs()` 替换为研究 worker 自己的 native executor 挂载。94/94 自动测试、构建、官方安装和实际 Host 通过；按用户指示使用同一 API 完成了真实聊天、2 个真实 GitHub 来源的后台研究与引用闭环。单样本不代表普遍研究质量；原生缩放、真实 IME/附件组合、屏幕阅读器和真人观察仍有限制。详见[本轮适配与验收](docs/implementation/2026-11-05-0.2.2-rc.1-adaptation.md)。0.4.0 为前一版本，仅支持 `0.2.1-rc.2`，历史验收见[0.4.0 记录](docs/implementation/2026-10-23-workflow-0.4.0.md)。

1. 卡片展示仓库图 / Logo，失败时尝试 GitHub owner 头像，再显示字标。GitHub 的 stars、最近代码推送时间、查询时间与来源链接分别显示。未知数据明确显示未知，0 stars 保留为 0。
2. `✓ 保留` / `✕ 排除`，再次点击同一选项恢复待处理；可展开填写原因。收藏、对比与筛选互相独立。
3. 点「加入对比」后打开「对比」，最多四个来源，可比较简介、stars、更新时间、语言、许可证及筛选理由。
4. 默认双列；面板内容宽度小于 620px 自动单列。深浅模式跟随 Host，包括设置下拉选项。需求、补充说明、原因草稿和对比选择按会话 / 主题保留在浏览器 sessionStorage。
5. 底部「补充查找」展开输入后，「继续查找」启动同主题新轮次，携带保留项、排除项与原因；「新搜索」展开新需求，点击开始才创建新集合，收起不会丢草稿。旧结果仍可从对话卡片查看。
6. 运行中可筛选、收藏、对比和引用；「停止研究」只停止该轮子任务。五分钟超时会结束研究并保留已到达候选。Host 重启后未恢复的研究显示中断，可重试。

选好资料，点 **「引用到对话（N 条）」**。主输入框原有正文、附件和引用保留，不会自动发送。然后续写，例如：

> 参考这几个仓库，学习其中的 UI 设计，结合本仓库现有组件提出优化并实现。

也可在主输入框输入 `@deck`，选择当前保留项或历史快照。引用保存标题、真实 URL、说明、metadata 和筛选原因的不可变快照；之后改判不会悄悄更改已插入的资料。点击引用可回看原主题，发送前可移除。

插入期间若用户继续输入、切会话或当前输入框不可用，会保留原草稿并提示重试；清除数据后的失效引用会阻止发送，需移除后重选。

次要入口「直接发送筛选摘要」立即投递摘要并把集合设为只读，失败可重试且使用同一请求身份。需要续写开发说明时优先使用引用。

卡片 ☆ 保存至当前 profile 共用收藏夹，支持搜索、移除、重新加入资料台。收藏会跨会话共享，重启保留。

设置页「资料台」提供可选的 GitHub / Web / LLM 自主来源策略，以及清除插件数据。策略用于提示和标记，不保证模型结果严格合规。卸载不会自动删除已有记录。

- 本地 `source_deck` 域保持八表：sets、sources、candidates、selections、scope_policies、session_active、rounds、favorites。旧记录可读取；搜索结果绑定原主题和轮次。
- 插件不读取凭据文件或保存 API Key。搜索提示与网页请求按 Host 的配置发送给提供方；外部内容序列化为资料数据，不能替代用户指令。
- 图片受原站、网络及 Host CSP 影响；失败不影响筛选或链接。模型未查证的 metadata 不应当作真实统计。
- 并发受模型提供方额度及官方子会话设置约束；不提供跨设备同步、导出或版本链 diff。
- 真实 Host 验收范围与未验收项目见 [验收记录](docs/SETUP-VERIFICATION.md)。

SourceDeck 还在早期，很多取舍可以一起讨论。欢迎 fork、提 issue、提 PR。

- **遇到问题**：开 issue，附上 DSH 版本、插件版本、复现步骤和相关日志；请先脱敏。
- **想改代码**：fork 后从 `main` 开分支，保持精确 peer，跑 `node --test tests/*.test.ts` 和 `npm run build`，在 PR 里说明动机、取舍和验证。
- **想补来源 / 场景**：欢迎补适配和测试；请避免把 alpha 专有 API 带进来。

不要求一次写完整个功能。一个清楚的场景、一条测试、一段文案，都是有价值的贡献。

[GitHub](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) · [0.4.1 prerelease](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.4.1) · [Stable 0.3.0](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.3.0) · [GitMCP](https://gitmcp.io/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck) · [Marketplace catalog](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/data/plugins/Archaofan__dsh-source-deck.yml)

SourceDeck is an open-source research workbench for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. It brings “let me see how others did it” out of a dozen browser tabs, scattered bookmarks, and chat history into one sidebar: background research, card-based screening, side-by-side comparison, and selected repositories referenced back into the current conversation.

Most product designs already have open-source implementations. Instead of reinventing the wheel, the usual move is to find a mature project, read its architecture, interactions, and tradeoffs, then decide whether to reuse it, borrow from it, or deliberately avoid it.

The hard part is rarely finding something. It is what happens after: how do you compare a dozen repositories quickly? Which ones did you review, and why did you reject them? How do you bring the selected ones back into the conversation so the Agent can continue against real code?

SourceDeck is built for that middle step. It turns a research pass into a traceable chain:

> state the need → background research → screen the cards → compare side by side → reference back into chat → keep building

Good for: technology selection, competitive or analogous project research, finding reusable implementations, and giving the Agent real background sources.  
Not for: replacing deep code audits or formal security/compliance review.

0.4.1 keeps the 0.4.0 interface; this round made no UI changes. These are actual 0.4.0 Host screenshots (light Chinese / dark English). QA sources are synthetic acceptance fixtures demonstrating search, sorting, comparison selection and undo.

| Light | Dark |
|---|---|
|  |  |
The deck is not a separate search page. It shares the same conversation context as the chat on the left, so research results, screening decisions, and references stay in one place.

1. **Start from chat**: type `/deck find a few mainstream agent frameworks...`, or simply say “use SourceDeck to find…”. The main Agent calls `deck_search` and starts an official managed child session; the main conversation stays usable.
2. **Results return to the same conversation**: candidates appear in the right-side deck, while the chat keeps a compact source card. “Open in deck” returns to the original topic. Internal search prompts stay in the child session and do not flood the main chat.
3. **Decide in the deck**: keep / exclude, write a reason, favorite, and compare up to four sources. Decisions are isolated per conversation/topic and never leak into another session.
4. **Reference back into chat**: click “Reference in chat”; kept sources enter the composer as an immutable snapshot. Existing draft text and attachments are preserved, and nothing is auto-sent. Then continue with “study these repositories and propose an improvement for our design”.
5. **Re-decisions do not rewrite inserted references**: later changes only affect future references. The inserted snapshot stays as it was and can be removed before sending.

The left side keeps the conversation going while the right-side deck stays in sync; the composer holds a SourceDeck reference and a follow-up instruction. These earlier-version screenshots illustrate the reference workflow:

Only public APIs from `0.2.2-rc.1` are used. 0.4.1 is the current prerelease adapted to that baseline; the published 0.4.0 only supports `0.2.1-rc.2` and will not load on 0.2.2-rc.1. Only this RC baseline is maintained; fast-moving alpha builds are not supported. Moving to a newer RC or a stable release requires a separate evaluation and acceptance pass.

Download `dsh-source-deck-0.4.1.tgz` from the [v0.4.1 Release](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.4.1), install it through the Desktop plugin manager, then restart when prompted. Environments still on `0.2.1-rc.2` should use the [v0.4.0 Release](https://github.com/Archaofan/dsh-source-deck/releases/tag/v0.4.0). During development, use a new version or a content-hashed tgz path: the package manager may cache the same version at the same path.

Market submission [PR #7739](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7739) is merged. Catalog update [PR #12339](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/12339) is open: it points the entry at 0.4.1 and notes `DSH 0.2.2-rc.1` support in both descriptions. **Until it merges, the catalog still points to 0.3.3 (old baseline)**; use the 0.4.1 Release package above. Catalog inclusion does not establish actual market-UI acceptance of any version. See [market status](docs/MARKETPLACE.en.md).

- Say `Use SourceDeck to find a few mainstream agent frameworks and compare stars and maintenance`. The model starts research with `deck_search`; natural-language triggering depends on its tool choice.
- For a deterministic entry, use `/deck Find extensible open-source Markdown editors`. Arguments start research; bare `/deck` only opens the deck.
- The composer button, right-sidebar `+ → Deck`, and conversation cards also open it. Historical cards target their original topic.

Research runs in an official managed child session, inheriting the parent's model configuration and credential policy. It creates extra concurrent model requests. The Host samples recent parent messages as context. Internal search/follow-up prompts remain in the child; the parent can continue development, with concise command/tool status and source cards.

Workers may only use `web_search`, `web_fetch`, and `deck_submit_sources`. Official web tools and the spawn provider must be available. Startup failure is explicit; the plugin does not change configuration or upgrade the baseline.

Search titles, URLs, notes, screening reasons and existing language, license and topic metadata together, for example `TypeScript MIT`. Space-separated terms must all match. Candidates and favorites remember separate queries and sorts. Original order is the default; candidates can be sorted within each round by stars, code push or name, with unknown values last.

The comparison list shows selected names, supports individual removal or clearing, and follows selection order with up to four sources. Below 620px, dimensions appear vertically with source labels; wider panes use a table. Undo restores the prior verdict and reason for the latest confirmed local choice; changing topics, later edits to that item or observed conflicts expire it.

Cards prioritize the existing Research judgment, with full notes and descriptions retained in details. New research prompts ask for task applicability and material uncertainty, and respect explicitly named sources or counts. These instructions do not guarantee factual accuracy. Queries, sorts, comparison choices and drafts continue between the composer entry and historical cards for the same topic.

Cards show saving status. References and direct summaries wait for pending screening writes; failed saves preserve drafts for retry. Reads occur approximately every two seconds during research and every thirty seconds for idle results. Periodic full reads pause in favorites or hidden panes and refresh on return.

0.4.1 adapts SourceDeck to DSH 0.2.2-rc.1; the only interface-level change replaces the removed `tools.presentAs()` with a native executor mounted in each research worker's own scope. All 94 tests, the build, official installation and the actual Host passed. With the user's same-API instruction, real chat, a two-source background research round and the reference round-trip were verified. One sample does not prove general research quality; native zoom, real IME/attachment combinations, screen-reader speech and human observation remain limited. See [this adaptation and acceptance](docs/implementation/2026-11-05-0.2.2-rc.1-adaptation.md). 0.4.0 is the previous version and only supports `0.2.1-rc.2`; see its [implementation and acceptance](docs/implementation/2026-10-23-workflow-0.4.0.en.md).

1. Cards show a project image/Logo, then try the GitHub owner avatar, then a monogram. GitHub stars, last code push, lookup time, and evidence link are separate. Unknown facts stay unknown; zero stars stay zero.
2. Keep or exclude; click the active verdict again to return to pending. Expand the optional reason. Favorites and comparison do not change verdicts.
3. Add up to four sources to the comparison panel for descriptions, stars, dates, languages, licenses, reasons, and URLs.
4. Cards default to two columns, automatically becoming one below 620px of panel content width. Light/dark modes follow the Host, including settings select options. Request/note/reason drafts and comparison choices are stored per session/topic in browser sessionStorage.
5. Open the follow-up editor to continue the same topic with current decisions and reasons. New search opens editing first; Start creates a new set. Cancelling preserves the draft and current results. Historical conversation cards reopen their original sets.
6. Screening, favorites, comparison, and references remain available during research. Stop affects only that worker. A five-minute timeout ends the task and keeps partial results. Unrest

Press **Reference in chat (N sources)**. Existing draft text, attachments, and references remain; nothing is auto-sent. Append an instruction such as:

> Study the UI designs in these repositories, consider our existing components, then propose and implement improvements.

You can also type `@deck` in the composer and choose the current kept sources or a historical snapshot. References store an immutable snapshot of title, real URL, note, metadata, and screening reason; later verdict changes do not silently rewrite inserted sources. Click a reference to revisit its topic, or remove it before sending.

If the draft changes, the session switches, or the composer becomes unavailable during insertion, the original draft is preserved and a retry is offered. References invalidated by cleared data block sending until removed and reselected.

The secondary “Send screening summary” action delivers a summary immediately and makes the set read-only. Retries reuse the same request identity. Prefer references when you need to continue with a development instruction.

The ☆ control saves a card to the profile-wide favorites library, with search, remove, and re-add. Favorites are shared across sessions and survive restarts.

The SourceDeck settings page offers optional GitHub / Web / LLM-freeform source policies and a clear-data action. Policies are hints and flags, not a guarantee that model results comply. Uninstalling does not automatically delete existing records.

- The local `source_deck` domain keeps eight tables: sets, sources, candidates, selections, scope_policies, session_active, rounds, and favorites. Legacy records remain readable; search results stay bound to their topic and round.
- The plugin does not read credential files or store API keys. Search prompts and web requests go to providers under the Host configuration; external content is serialized as source data and never becomes user instructions.
- Images depend on the origin site, network, and Host CSP; failures do not affect screening or links. Metadata that the model did not verify should not be treated as real statistics.
- Concurrency is bounded by provider quota and official child-session settings. There is no cross-device sync, export, or version-chain diff.
- The real-Host acceptance scope and remaining gaps are documented in the [verification record](docs/SETUP-VERIFICATION.md).
SourceDeck is still early, and many tradeoffs are worth discussing together. Fork it, open an issue, or send a PR.

- **Found a problem**: open an issue with the DSH version, plugin version, reproduction steps, and relevant logs. Redact secrets first.
- **Want to change code**: fork, branch from `main`, keep the exact peers, run `node --test tests/*.test.ts` and `npm run build`, and explain the motivation, tradeoffs, and verification in the PR.
- **Want to add a source or scenario**: adapters and tests are welcome; please do not bring in alpha-only APIs.
You do not need to finish a whole feature. A clear scenario, one test, or one paragraph of documentation is a valuable contribution.
